pages.text: HF radios hiss with $(thing)static$(); a strong signal pushes it down, a weak one stays buried in it.$(li)$(thing)Redstone$() switching near your coax or antenna crackles in the receiver: keep clocks away.$(li)$(thing)Lightning$() crashes on every radio in the dimension.
It works both ways: a transmitter induces a signal in dust near its antenna and can flip levers, buttons and torches nearby, further with a bad SWR. QRP rigs reach less.
